name: Revenue IF Berhad
overview: 2026年公司完成名称变更，由 Revenue Group Berhad 改为 Revenue IF Berhad；年内进行多次集资活动，并披露持续经营相关的重大不确定性及审计保留意见。业务板块方面，公告资料未显示各业务线有具体的扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: In 2026, the company completed its name change from Revenue Group Berhad to Revenue IF Berhad; it carried out several fund-raising exercises during the year and disclosed a material uncertainty related to going concern and a qualified audit opinion. Regarding business segments, the announcements do not show specific expansion, reduction, or contract developments for any business line.

segments.name: 集团 / Group

segments.note_en: Completed the company name change during the year and carried out several fund-raising exercises; the audit report disclosed a material uncertainty related to going concern and a qualified opinion.
